incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: Sudden p99 latency spike detected for rwd-serving-usw2. p99=2.1s (normal ~420ms), p95=900ms. Streaming stall ratio up to 5.2% over 5m. kv eviction bursts and slab fragmentation high (~75%). Auto-flagging to #eng-oncall.

Maya: seeing this on the latency dashboards. Lots of tail errors on streaming sessions. Any runtime folks awake?

Lin: I'm on it. Metrics look like heavy prefill churn on shard delta. decode worker queues are climbing and CPU steal on those hosts is high. Quick snapshot: 
```
kv.prefill.requests.5m=27k
kv.prefill.miss_rate=86%
kv.decode.queue_len=410
kv.slab.used_pct=94
kv.slab.frag_pct=75
streaming.stalls.5m=142
```

Raj: hypothesis: hot-key prefill churn causing many small evictions and synchronous re-decode, which blocks streaming frames and increases p99. Two suspects: cust-117 and cust-881 long-chat sessions are top traffic. Can we get slab detail for shard delta?

Lin: running kvctl slab-stat --shard=delta output: 
```
shard: delta
  total_bytes: 192GB
  used_bytes: 180GB
  avg_frag=28KB
  eviction_rate=880/s
  prefill:decode=5.2
  hot_keys: cust-117-chat*, cust-881-convo*
```

Priya: customer impact: cust-117 & cust-881 reporting laggy conversations, support tickets INC-4710 and INC-4711 opened. Approx 15% of their requests >1s. CS wants ETA and mitigation.

Maya: propose live mitigations: 1) apply targeted per-key prefill throttle for the offending prefixes; 2) flip the prefill fallback to async (don’t block decode thread) via runtime toggle; 3) allocate emergency slab slack on shard delta; 4) route new streams for lower-tier traffic to a smaller model variant to reduce decode pressure.

Lin: implementing 1 & 3 now. Commands executed: 
```
kvctl set-rate --shard=delta --prefixes "cust-117*","cust-881*" --rps 8
kvctl reserve-slab --shard=delta --percent 12
```

DeployBot: Rolling config update to runtime-config (deploy id dply-8606129) to set runtime.feature.prefill_async=true on canary nodes.

Maya: enabling async prefill on 3 canary hosts to validate behavior.

Lin: canary results look promising. decode.queue_len dropped 410 -> 95 in ~90s on canaries, eviction_rate fell to ~200/s. Streaming stalls on canary hosts down ~75%.

Priya: notifying CS and affected AEs with the following note: "We observed a prefill-driven cache pressure event affecting cust-117 and cust-881. We've applied targeted throttles and switched prefill to async to reduce blocking. Expect noticeable improvement within 10-25 minutes. Will follow up with RCA and compensation guidance as needed."

Raj: monitoring cluster-wide. p99 has reduced to ~1.1s in the last 5m, p95 back to 520ms. Still not at SLA but trending. Need a plan for durable fix: either grow slab for shard delta, smarter hot-key sharding, or an eviction policy that avoids evicting long-lived entries.

Maya: immediate next steps for this shift: 
- Keep targeted throttles for 2 hours, then evaluate.
- Complete hot-key rebalance (move heavy keys to other shards) if eviction rate doesn't drop under 250/s.
- If rebalance OK, consider permanent slab increase for shard delta.
- Prepare postmortem w/ timeline, customer impact, metric diffs, and follow-up remediation.

Lin: kicking off rebalance: 
```
kvctl rebalance --shard=delta --strategy=spread-hotkeys --concurrency=200 --no-dryrun
```
Background job id reb-8606129 started (est 22m). Progress updates will be posted here every 2m.

SupportBot: INC-4710/INC-4711 updated: mitigation applied, customers notified, escalation path open.

Priya: holding on compensation decision until we have full SLA window calc. CS asked for interim FAQ copy, prepping.

Maya: handoff notes for next oncall (Raj taking): active mitigations: per-key throttle, prefill set to async on runtime, slab reserve added, rebalance job running. Watchlist: 
- p99 target <700ms within 1h
- streaming.stalls trending down to <1%
- kv.slab.frag_pct dropping from 75 -> <45 during rebalance
- rebalance errors or network saturation while moving keys
- ticket updates INC-4710/4711

Raj: taking handoff. I'll monitor for 90m and start capacity planning for slab growth. Creating RCA ticket RCA-8606129 and logging the timeline.

Maya: summary for RCA: root cause = concentrated, high-rate prefill traffic on limited-key set causing slab fragmentation and decode blocking -> streaming stalls -> p99 spike. Containment: targeted throttles, changed prefill to async, reserved slab headroom, started hot-key rebalance, notified customers.

Lin: adding perf snapshots and command logs to RCA.

Maya: signing off live triage. Marking incident state: mitigated -> monitoring. Incident ticket INC-8606129. Handoff complete. :white_check_mark:
